SEPARATE_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.title: Accept this with a separate account
SEPARATE_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.description: You are signed in with a player or coach account, and running a club takes an account of its own. Sign out, sign in with a different Google or Microsoft account, and open this link again.

CLUB_ACCOUNT_TAKEN.title: Your club account already belongs to a club
CLUB_ACCOUNT_TAKEN.description: A club account belongs to one club. To help run this one as well, accept with a separate account: sign out, sign in with a different Google or Microsoft account, and open this link again.

PLAYER_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.title: Accept this with your player account
PLAYER_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.description: This invitation is for a player, and you are signed in with a club or coach account. Sign out, sign in with your player account, and open this link again.

COACH_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.title: This invitation needs a coach account
COACH_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED.description: Coach accounts are not open yet, so it cannot be accepted with this account. Ask the club to contact playerz.bg.

ACCOUNT_KIND_UNDECIDED.title: Your account is waiting for a decision
ACCOUNT_KIND_UNDECIDED.description: It held roles at more than one club, or a coach role, before every account had a single kind. playerz.bg will settle which account it is; until then it cannot accept invitations.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.subtitle: A code from an authenticator app on your phone. Required for every platform action that changes a club’s data — review moderation included.
security.notEligible: Two-step verification is available to platform administrators who hold a live grant.

enrol.intro: You will need an authenticator app on your phone that shows six-digit codes changing every 30 seconds.
enrol.step1: Add the account to your app
enrol.scan: Scan this code with the authenticator app on your phone.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code with the key for your authenticator app. If you can’t scan it, type the key in by hand.
enrol.manual: Or type this key in by hand, choosing “time-based”:
enrol.step2: Enter the six-digit code the app shows
enrol.reauth: To turn this on, sign in again: sign out, sign back in, and open this page within 15 minutes.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: Each code works once, for when you cannot reach your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: you will not see them again.
recovery.regenerateHint: The old codes stop working. Needs a code confirmation in the last 15 minutes.

stepUp.inactive: This device has not been confirmed in the last 15 minutes.

security.lost: Lost your phone and your recovery codes? Contact the platform team — only an operator can reset it.
